question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted and are running on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most instance network info cache records in availability zone 'flare3', show each display name along with its cache record count, the memory range (max minus min, in MB) and memory variance (in MB) computed across non-deleted instances that have a non-empty key name, and also include the average vCPU count for those non-deleted, keyed instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopCacheByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT t.display_name, t.cache_records, m.memory_range_mb, m.memory_variance_mb FROM TopCacheByDisplayName t JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName m ON t.display_name = m.display_name ORDER BY t.cache_records DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, v.avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name) AS v ON v.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC;

question: For each availability zone, among instances that are not deleted and that are running on host "prime-35" (joining through the instance UUID to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), return the maximum instance count observed across VM states in that availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE) SELECT AVAILABILITY_ZONE, MAX(instance_count) AS max_instance_count_across_vm_states FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE;
sub_questions: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted and that are running on host "prime-35", return the number of instances and the earliest instance creation time, using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache.
sub_sqls: SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE;

question: For each instance display name, show the display name and the geometric mean of the instance memory (in MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', where the memory is greater than 0, and only for instances running on host 'blaze8-12'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each VM state, list the VM state, the total number of instances that are on host 'blaze8-12' and have at least one instance system metadata entry where the metadata key is 'image_image_type', and the number of distinct users for those instances. Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_instances_with_image_type_metadata FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name) = vm_state_name THEN NULL ELSE vm_state_name END AS vm_state, total_instances, distinct_users FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.VM_STATE END AS vm_state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS total_instances, COUNT(DISTINCT i.USER_ID) AS distinct_users FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vm_state_sort, vm_state_name;
sub_questions: Count how many instances have a VM state of 'shelved_offloaded', are on host 'blaze8-12', and also have at least one instance system metadata entry where the metadata key is 'image_image_type'.
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_instances_with_image_type_metadata FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type';

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", find each system metadata key and the maximum vCPUs among instances that have that key, using the per-instance metadata listing (with row numbers per key ordered by instance UUID) as an inner CTE. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT metadata_key, MAX(vcpus) AS max_vcpus_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key;
sub_questions: For instances in availability zone "flare3", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the associated system metadata key and value, and assign row numbers within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID.

question: From the top 10 VM states with the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among non-deleted instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, display each VM state’s average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory, along with (for comparison) each migration status’s average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) considering only non-deleted migrations (and only instances that also have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA). Additionally, for each VM state, show the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) used by instances in that VM state, and whether there exist any active (non-completed/failed/error) non-deleted migrations for instances in that VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH vm_state_stats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), migration_status_stats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_vm_state_by_variance AS ( SELECT VM_STATE, memory_mb_variance FROM vm_state_stats LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tvs.VM_STATE, vss.avg_memory_mb AS vm_state_avg_memory_mb, vss.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, vss.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, mss.status AS migration_status, mss.avg_memory_mb AS migration_status_avg_memory_mb, mss.memory_mb_variance AS migration_status_memory_mb_variance, mss.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_status_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_vm_state_by_variance tvs JOIN vm_state_stats vss ON tvs.VM_STATE = vss.VM_STATE CROSS JOIN migration_status_stats mss ORDER BY tvs.memory_mb_variance DESC, mss.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_status_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_stddev, SUM(i.vcpus) AS vm_state_total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.vm_state = ic.vm_state AND i2.deleted = 0 AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = ic.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY ic.VM_STATE, ic.vm_state_avg_memory_mb, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance, ic.vm_state_memory_mb_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_status_avg_memory_mb, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY ic.vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, ic.migration_status_memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 instance display names (matching the regular expression 'prime' and not deleted) with the largest range in network-info cache record counts per instance, show each display name along with the cache-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for those same display names among not-deleted instances running on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH cache_metrics AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), memory_cv AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), top_cache_range AS ( SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, cache_count_range FROM cache_metrics ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tcr.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.cache_count_range, cm.cache_count_variance, cm.cache_count_stddev, mc.coefficient_of_variation FROM top_cache_range tcr JOIN cache_metrics cm ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcr.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN memory_cv mc ON mc.display_name = tcr.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cm.cache_count_range DESC;

question: For each instance display name on host blaze8-12, return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance’s root disk size (ROOT_GB) across only those system-metadata rows where the metadata key is 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each instance power state, list the power state, total number of instances, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty network_info entry in the instance info cache. Do not repeat the power state if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.power_state, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.power_state ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(power_state_name) OVER (ORDER BY power_state_sort, power_state_name) = power_state_name THEN NULL ELSE power_state_name END AS power_state, total_power_states, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 THEN 999999 ELSE inner_cte.power_state END AS power_state_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.power_state) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CAST(inner_cte.power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state_name, COUNT(*) AS total_power_states, AVG(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) AS memory_mb_variance, AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.power_state WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY power_state_sort, power_state_name;
sub_questions: For each instance power state, show the average, variance, and standard deviation of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty network_info entry in the instance info cache.

sql: WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataWindow imw JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON imw.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY imw.display_name, imw.uuid;

question: For instances with display name "forge", give (1) the total count of instances whose memory-per-vCPU ratio is greater than 2048 MB per vCPU, (2) the total count of instances whose memory is greater than 75% of the maximum memory among these "forge" instances, and (3) the ratio of (1) to (2).
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, ie.flavor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY i.hostname ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.hostname, ic.flavor, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) AS memory_per_vcpu_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = ic.uuid WHERE (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) > 2048 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / (SELECT MAX(inner_cte2.memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) > 0.75 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Meeting_MemoryPerVcpu_Threshold, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Above_75pct_Max_Memory, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid), 0), 2 ) AS Ratio_MemoryPerVcpuQualified_To_Above75pctMaxMemory FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: For the top 10 instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' with the highest average MEMORY_MB among instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the display name, the minimum instance ID, the average memory (MB), whether any instance with that display name has more than one system-metadata row, and also the (non-deleted) memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and deviation from the overall average memory range for that display name. sql: WITH top10_by_avg_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = i.display_name GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.id = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), display_name_memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT t.display_name, t.min_instance_id, t.avg_memory_mb, t.has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows, s.memory_mb_range, s.memory_mb_variance, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM top10_by_avg_memory t JOIN display_name_memory_stats s ON s.display_name = t.display_name ORDER BY t.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance network info, along with the average migration id within each status group, and also include (per instance display name) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining; finally compute the ratio of migration id to that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) and order by this ratio descending.
sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, md.NETWORK_INFO, md.window_column, imv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(md.migration_id / NULLIF(imv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryVariation imv ON md.instance_display_name = imv.display_name ORDER BY migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio DESC;

question: For each instance display name, list the display name, total number of matching instances, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_days_to_launch, days_to_launch_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.uuid) AS total_instances, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), MigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PrimeInstancesWithImageType AS ( SELECT DISTINCT i.display_name FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmrcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats ims JOIN MigrationMemoryRemainingCV mmrcv ON ims.display_name = mmrcv.display_name WHERE ims.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM PrimeInstancesWithImageType) ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmrcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory (in MB) for completed migrations where the instance is not deleted (DELETED = 0) and the display name matches the pattern 'prime', but only include those instance display names whose average instance memory is greater than the overall average instance memory across all such matching completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 );

question: For each project that has at least one instance whose display name is "forge", find the project ID and the highest total vCPUs used by any VM state within that project, where the per-VM-state totals are computed from the full "forge" instance details (including instance-info-cache and the VM-state-matched migration status summary for instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), ProjectVmStateTotals AS ( SELECT ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, SUM(ic.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.project_id, ic.vm_state ) SELECT project_id, MAX(total_vcpus_in_vm_state) AS max_total_vcpus_by_vm_state FROM ProjectVmStateTotals GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id;

question: For each inclusion reason (either “Forge Window Rank” or “High Root Disk”), list the reason label, the number of included instances, and the number of distinct projects those instances belong to. Include subtotals per reason and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS ( SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), HighRootGBInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.UUID HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > ( SELECT AVG(ROOT_GB) + STDDEV(ROOT_GB) FROM INSTANCES ) ), CombinedInstances AS ( SELECT fwr.uuid AS instance_uuid, fwr.window_column, NULL AS total_root_gb, 'Forge Window Rank' AS reason FROM ForgeWindowRanks fwr UNION ALL SELECT hri.instance_uuid, NULL AS window_column, hri.total_root_gb, 'High Root Disk' AS reason FROM HighRootGBInstances hri ) SELECT instance_uuid, window_column, total_root_gb, reason FROM CombinedInstances ORDER BY instance_uuid, reason ), ReasonRollup AS ( SELECT inner_cte.reason, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances, COUNT(DISTINCT i.project_id) AS total_projects FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances, SUM(total_projects) AS total_projects FROM ReasonRollup GROUP BY reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each VM state, show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value recorded in the instance extra table, along with the overall average of the per-VM-state average memory across all VM states. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, min_instance_id, avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, min_instance_id, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.DISPLAY_NAME END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.DISPLAY_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.DISPLAY_NAME END AS display_name, MIN(inner_cte.min_instance_id) AS min_instance_id, AVG(inner_cte.avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.min_instance_id = i.ID GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.min_instance_id, q2.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN q2.display_name = 'TOTAL' THEN NULL WHEN q1.DISPLAY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above_overall_avg_per_display_name FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN q2.display_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q2.display_name;

sql: WITH completed_migrations_per_instance AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.availability_zone, c.completed_migration_count, c.total_memory_processed, s.min_instance_id, s.avg_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_per_instance c JOIN instance_memory_stats_by_display_name s ON c.instance_display_name = s.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.completed_migration_count DESC, c.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For each instance virtual machine state on host "blaze8-12", show the VM state, the average/range/variance of instance memory (in MB), and the percentage of that VM state's average memory relative to the overall average memory across all qualifying instances (not deleted and with a non-empty network_info cache entry). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / overall.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_vs_overall_ratio FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic2 ON iic2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DELETED = 0 AND iic2.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) AS overall ORDER BY avg_memory_vs_overall_ratio DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12', list each display name, its completed migration count, and the average completed migration count per instance across all instances on 'blaze8-12'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations, avg_migrations.avg_migrations_per_instance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migrations_per_instance FROM ( SELECT i.uuid, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid ) AS per_instance ) AS avg_migrations ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC;

question: For each instance display name that matches the pattern 'prime' (and is not deleted), show the memory range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across that instance’s records, along with the overall average of the per-display-name memory ranges across all such display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, avg_ranges.avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_ranges ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For the rollup rows produced (including subtotals and the grand total) from (1) instances on host 'prime-35' that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' summarized by instance display name, and (2) instances in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12' that have at least one system metadata entry summarized by system metadata key, list the display name rollup row, its total memory range (MB) and average memory variance (MB), the metadata key rollup row with its minimum memory (MB) and total vCPUs, the overall minimum memory and overall total vCPUs, and compute the vCPU share of overall total vCPUs for each metadata-key rollup row.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(memory_range_mb) AS total_memory_range_mb, AVG(memory_variance_mb) AS avg_memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), KeyAgg AS ( SELECT ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ism.KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, SUM(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus, (SELECT min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_min_memory_mb, (SELECT total_vcpus FROM inner_cte) AS overall_total_vcpus FROM KeyAgg GROUP BY metadata_key WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_memory_range_mb, q1.avg_memory_variance_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.min_memory_mb, q2.total_vcpus, q2.overall_min_memory_mb, q2.overall_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.total_vcpus / NULLIF(q2.overall_total_vcpus, 0), 4) AS vcpu_share_of_overall FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.display_name, q2.metadata_key;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime', considering only completed migrations (and only instances with a non-deleted instance info cache entry), show each display name’s migration memory_total range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) with the overall average memory_total range as a benchmark and variability category, alongside its completed migration count with the average migration count benchmark and migration category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ic.memory_total_stddev, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), mig_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY migration_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.DISPLAY_NAME, c.migration_count, a.avg_migration_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.migration_count > a.avg_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN c.migration_count < a.avg_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY c.migration_count DESC, c.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance, ms.memory_total_stddev, ms.benchmark AS avg_memory_total_range_benchmark, ms.variability_category, mc.migration_count, mc.benchmark AS avg_migration_count_benchmark, mc.migration_category FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mig_counts mc ON ms.display_name = mc.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY mc.migration_count DESC, ms.memory_total_range DESC, ms.display_name;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE (i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' OR i.VCPUS >= 8) AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = i.display_name AND ie2.migration_context IS NOT NULL AND ie2.migration_context <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_migration_context FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.id = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instances that have at least 2 completed migrations, list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) across system metadata rows (only for display names with at least 3 system metadata entries), the number of completed migrations, and the total memory processed across those completed migrations. sql: WITH InstanceMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), CompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT cms.instance_uuid, cms.display_name, cms.availability_zone, ims.memory_mb_stddev, cms.migration_count, cms.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationStats cms JOIN InstanceMemoryStddev ims ON cms.display_name = ims.display_name WHERE cms.migration_count >= 2 ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3", among the top 10 instance display names (restricted to instances that have system metadata KEY = "image_image_type") ranked by average memory (MB), show each display name’s minimum instance ID, average memory, whether any instance with that display name has system metadata KEY = "image_image_location", and—joined by display name—the per-(VM state, display name) instance count and minimum memory for instances with more than 8 VCPUs, along with the overall average of those per-(VM state, display name) instance counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH top_display_names_by_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), vm_state_display_name_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, avg_counts.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts ) SELECT tdn.DISPLAY_NAME, tdn.min_instance_id, tdn.avg_memory_mb, tdn.has_image_location_metadata, vsd.VM_STATE, vsd.instance_count, vsd.min_memory_mb, vsd.avg_instance_count FROM top_display_names_by_memory AS tdn JOIN vm_state_display_name_counts AS vsd ON vsd.DISPLAY_NAME = tdn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY tdn.avg_memory_mb DESC, vsd.VM_STATE, vsd.instance_count DESC;

question: For each VM state that (1) has more than 50,000 MB of total instance memory in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12” and (2) also exceeds the non-deleted host-level benchmark on “blaze8-12”, list the VM state, the total memory and benchmark used for the “flare3”+host rollup (with its HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE memory category), and the total memory and benchmark used for the non-deleted host rollup (with its ABOVE_BENCHMARK/NOT_ABOVE_BENCHMARK category). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH az_host_memory_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.total_memory_mb, a.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > a.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < a.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), host_nondeleted_memory_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) AS benchmark_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.total_memory_mb, b.benchmark_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > b.benchmark_memory_mb THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'NOT_ABOVE_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ) SELECT a.VM_STATE, a.total_memory_mb AS az_host_total_memory_mb, a.benchmark AS az_host_avg_total_memory_benchmark_mb, a.memory_category AS az_host_memory_category, h.total_memory_mb AS host_nondeleted_total_memory_mb, h.benchmark AS host_nondeleted_benchmark_memory_mb, h.benchmark_category AS host_nondeleted_benchmark_category FROM az_host_memory_by_state a JOIN host_nondeleted_memory_by_state h ON a.VM_STATE = h.vm_state ORDER BY a.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of matching instance-extra records (considering only instances in the “flare3” availability zone that are hosted on “blaze8-12”), list the display name, the extra-record count, and the average memory (MB) of the instances in each display name group. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY extra_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, extra_records, avg_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, SUM(inner_cte.extra_records) AS extra_records, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name;

question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3" that also had at least one completed migration with positive memory processed, return the VM state and the maximum total memory processed (in bytes) across those instances, where each instance’s total memory processed is summed over its completed migrations. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), AZFlare3InstanceNetworkRank AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT az.UUID AS instance_uuid, az.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, az.VM_STATE, az.MEMORY_MB, az.NETWORK_INFO, az.window_column AS vm_state_memory_rank, cm.completed_migration_count, cm.total_memory_processed FROM AZFlare3InstanceNetworkRank az JOIN CompletedMigrationsByInstance cm ON az.UUID = cm.instance_uuid WHERE cm.availability_zone = 'flare3' ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE AS vm_state, MAX(inner_cte.total_memory_processed) AS max_total_memory_processed_bytes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE;

question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime', show the per-display-name instance count, average memory (MB), and memory variance (MB) (including the TOTAL rollup row), and for those same display names list the system metadata rows for non-deleted instances on host 'blaze8-12' whose memory is above the average memory of all non-deleted instances on that host, including instance UUID, VM state, metadata key/value, and the rank of each metadata row within its key group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH prime_displayname_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name ), blaze8_12_metadata_rows AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.KEY, inner_cte.VALUE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID WHERE i2.MEMORY_MB > ( SELECT AVG(i3.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) FROM INSTANCES AS i3 WHERE i3.DELETED = 0 AND i3.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) ) SELECT pds.display_name, pds.total_instances, pds.avg_memory_mb, pds.memory_mb_variance, bmr.UUID AS instance_uuid, bmr.VM_STATE AS vm_state, bmr.KEY AS system_metadata_key, bmr.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, bmr.window_column AS metadata_rank_within_key FROM prime_displayname_stats AS pds JOIN blaze8_12_metadata_rows AS bmr ON bmr.DISPLAY_NAME = pds.display_name ORDER BY pds.display_name, bmr.KEY, bmr.window_column, bmr.UUID;

sql: WITH MigrationMemoryWindow AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), InstanceMemoryVarianceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_variance - a.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stats a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.instance_display_name, mmw.instance_memory_mb, mmw.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mmw.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imvs.memory_mb_variance, imvs.memory_mb_stddev, imvs.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryWindow mmw JOIN InstanceMemoryVarianceStats imvs ON mmw.instance_display_name = imvs.display_name ORDER BY mmw.migration_id;

sql: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), avg_ranges AS (SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.memory_range_mb - ar.avg_memory_range_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ranges ar ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC ), migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY migration_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.DISPLAY_NAME, c.migration_count, a.avg_migration_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.migration_count > a.avg_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN c.migration_count < a.avg_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY c.migration_count DESC, c.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb, mig.migration_count, mig.benchmark AS avg_migration_count_benchmark, mig.migration_category FROM mem_stats ms JOIN migration_stats mig ON ms.display_name = mig.display_name ORDER BY mig.migration_category, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_range_mb DESC, mig.migration_count DESC, ms.display_name;

question: For each instance display name, show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between when the instance was created and when its instance info cache record was last updated, considering only instances that are not deleted and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'. sql: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH windowed_instances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), host_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM windowed_instances) AS flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_memory_stats) AS blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM windowed_instances wi CROSS JOIN host_memory_stats hms LIMIT 1 ) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations, inner_cte.flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, inner_cte.blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id, inner_cte.flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, inner_cte.blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations ORDER BY total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 5;

How many instances in availability zone "flare3" have a completed migration and a display name matching the pattern "flare", and how many instance display names on host "blaze8-12" have completed migrations (with average and standard deviation of memory remaining computed per display name)?
sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare';

SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC;

WITH windowed_instances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), host_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM windowed_instances) AS flare3_flare_completed_migration_instance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_memory_stats) AS blaze8_12_display_name_count_with_completed_migrations FROM windowed_instances wi CROSS JOIN host_memory_stats hms LIMIT 1;

question: For non-deleted instances in the VM state “shelved_offloaded”, show the (non-repeated) system metadata key, instance UUID, display name, power state, metadata value, cached network_info JSON, the per-metadata-key row number, plus the total rows and average power state per metadata key; also attach (when available by matching display name and network_info) the non-deleted instance details for instances whose memory_mb is greater than the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances, including that instance’s display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and dense rank by project_id. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb) SELECT q1.metadata_key, q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name AS shelved_display_name, q1.power_state, q1.metadata_value, q1.network_info AS shelved_network_info, q1.window_column AS per_key_row_number, q1.total_rows_per_key, q1.avg_power_state_per_key, q2.display_name AS high_mem_display_name, q2.vm_state AS high_mem_vm_state, q2.memory_mb AS high_mem_memory_mb, q2.network_info AS high_mem_network_info, q2.window_column AS high_mem_dense_rank FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name AND q1.network_info = q2.network_info ORDER BY q1.metadata_key, q1.instance_uuid;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded';

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, the instance-extra creation timestamp, and the row number ordered by the system metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and also include (for display name 'forge' considering only completed migrations) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system-metadata rows per migration. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t2.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.extra_created_at, f.window_column, p.metadata_count_range, p.metadata_count_variance, p.metadata_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS f JOIN PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS p ON p.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.window_column, f.metadata_key;

question: For each migration status, show the status, the total amount of memory processed across migrations for instances whose system metadata key is 'image_image_type', the average total processed memory across all such active statuses as a benchmark, and categorize each status as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Consider only active migrations (excluding statuses 'accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') and only include statuses where the total processed memory is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > 0 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_processed) AS avg_total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.total_memory_processed, a.avg_total_memory_processed AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_processed > a.avg_total_memory_processed * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_processed < a.avg_total_memory_processed * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;
domain_knowledge: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
sub_questions: For each migration status, show the status and the total amount of memory processed across migrations for instances whose system metadata key is 'image_image_type', considering only active migrations (i.e., excluding statuses 'accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed'), and only include statuses where the total processed memory is greater than 0.

question: For host "blaze8-12", which VM states have (1) average/range/variance of instance memory (MB) for non-deleted instances with non-empty network_info, and (2) average/range/variance of instance root disk size (ROOT_GB) for instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH memory_stats_by_vm_state AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND iic.NETWORK_INFO <> '[]' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), root_disk_stats_by_vm_state AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT ms.vm_state, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, rs.avg_root_gb, rs.root_gb_range, rs.root_gb_variance FROM memory_stats_by_vm_state ms JOIN root_disk_stats_by_vm_state rs ON rs.VM_STATE = ms.vm_state;

SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for the 'forge' display name computed over instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. sql: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fimw.instance_uuid, fimw.hostname, fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow fimw JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column;

question: Among the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries (counting only non-deleted instances and only metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'), what is the maximum number of vCPUs of any instance in each display name group? Return the instance display name, the metadata entry count, and the maximum vCPU count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries, MAX(i2.VCPUS) AS max_vcpus_in_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_entries ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_entries DESC;
