question: For completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", considering only instances whose display name also appears among instances on "blaze8-12" with non-empty cached network information, list the migration ID, instance display name, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) for that display name, the instance system metadata key and value, and the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, but only for display names whose geometric mean memory is greater than the overall average of these geometric means. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mimw.migration_id, mimw.instance_display_name, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, mimw.metadata_key, mimw.metadata_value, mimw.window_column FROM MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS mimw JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS gmm ON mimw.instance_display_name = gmm.display_name ORDER BY mimw.instance_display_name, mimw.migration_id, mimw.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, geometric_mean_memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte);

question: How many completed migrations involve instances whose display name is among the “shelved_offloaded” instances with total memory greater than 50000 MB and also above the average total memory of those qualifying instances, and how many such high-memory shelved instance display names are there? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH completed_migration_memory_deviation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ), InstanceMemory AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory ) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ORDER BY im.migration_id ), high_memory_shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cmd.migration_id) AS completed_migrations_for_high_memory_shelved_instances_count, COUNT(DISTINCT hms.DISPLAY_NAME) AS high_memory_shelved_instance_display_names_count FROM completed_migration_memory_deviation cmd JOIN high_memory_shelved_instances hms ON cmd.instance_display_name = hms.DISPLAY_NAME;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH stddev_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), variance_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT s.display_name, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_stddev, v.memory_mb_variance, v.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM stddev_by_display_name s JOIN variance_by_display_name v ON s.display_name = v.display_name ORDER BY s.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH image_type_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.VALUE ORDER BY t1.UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t0.DELETED = 0), ValueCounts AS ( SELECT metadata_value, COUNT(*) AS value_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_value ), AvgValueCount AS ( SELECT AVG(value_instance_count * 1.0) AS avg_value_instance_count FROM ValueCounts ) SELECT i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.metadata_value, i.network_info FROM inner_cte i JOIN ValueCounts vc ON i.metadata_value = vc.metadata_value WHERE vc.value_instance_count > (SELECT avg_value_instance_count FROM AvgValueCount) ), top10_display_names_flare3 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ita.instance_uuid) AS matching_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.display_name) AS matching_display_name_count FROM image_type_above_avg ita JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.uuid = ita.instance_uuid JOIN top10_display_names_flare3 t10 ON t10.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3';

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb ) SELECT q1.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.network_info, q2.window_column, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that (1) have a display name matching the pattern “flare” and (2) are running on host “blaze8-12”, show the instance UUID, hostname, display name, VM state, memory in MB, instance extra record ID, instance extra created timestamp, cached network_info JSON, the windowed average memory_mb from each subquery (2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), and the difference between those two windowed averages; additionally, only return those instances whose instance_extra record was created after the average instance_extra created timestamp for instances in the same VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH FlareNamePatternInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), BlazeHostInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, b.display_name, b.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_extra_created_at, b.network_info, f.window_column AS flare_namepattern_window_avg_memory_mb, b.window_column AS blaze_host_window_avg_memory_mb, (f.window_column - b.window_column) AS window_avg_memory_mb_difference FROM FlareNamePatternInstances f JOIN BlazeHostInstances b ON b.uuid = f.instance_uuid ORDER BY f.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.instance_extra_created_at, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.flare_namepattern_window_avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.blaze_host_window_avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_avg_memory_mb_difference FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON ie2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE ie2.created_at > ( SELECT AVG(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ie3.created_at)) FROM instances i3 JOIN instance_extra ie3 ON ie3.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.vm_state = i2.vm_state ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb;

sql: WITH MemoryVarianceFromMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT mv.DISPLAY_NAME, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, mr.memory_range_mb, mr.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(mv.memory_mb_variance / NULLIF(mr.memory_range_mb, 0), 4) AS variance_to_range_ratio FROM MemoryVarianceFromMetadata mv JOIN MemoryRangeAndVariance mr ON mv.DISPLAY_NAME = mr.display_name ORDER BY variance_to_range_ratio DESC;

question: For security group rules whose parent security group has the name "aurum-xenon", list the rule protocol and a rule activity status ("Active" if the rule is not deleted and "Inactive" otherwise), along with the number of rules in each category. Include subtotals for each protocol and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL AS rule_protocol, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY sgr.CIDR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), RuleStatusCounts AS ( SELECT ic.rule_protocol, CASE WHEN sgr2.DELETED = 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS rule_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr2 ON sgr2.CIDR = ic.rule_cidr AND sgr2.PROTOCOL = ic.rule_protocol GROUP BY ic.rule_protocol, rule_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rule_protocol END AS rule_protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rule_status END AS rule_status, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleStatusCounts GROUP BY rule_protocol, rule_status WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), HighMemoryProcessedInstances AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations ) ) SELECT c.display_name, c.availability_zone, c.status, c.migration_type, c.uuid, c.window_column, h.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost c JOIN HighMemoryProcessedInstances h ON c.uuid = h.instance_uuid;

question: For instance display names that match the pattern 'prime' (and have at least 3 system metadata rows) and also appear on host 'blaze8-12' with system-metadata key 'image_image_type', return each display name along with (1) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across its system metadata rows and (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB across those 'image_image_type' system-metadata rows. sql: WITH MemoryStddevPrime AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT msp.display_name, msp.memory_mb_stddev, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM MemoryStddevPrime AS msp JOIN RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS rgb ON rgb.display_name = msp.display_name ORDER BY msp.memory_mb_stddev DESC, rgb.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), AverageRank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_rank AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > ar.avg_window_rank * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RANK' WHEN ic.window_column < ar.avg_window_rank * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RANK' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RANK' END AS rank_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRank ar ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb, AVG(q2.window_column) AS avg_dense_rank_for_display_name, AVG(q2.benchmark) AS overall_rank_benchmark, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'HIGH_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'LOW_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'AVERAGE_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For completed migrations involving instances on host "blaze8-12", list each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over a window ordered by migration id that includes the current row and the next 2 rows, but only for VM states that account for more than 10% of all completed migrations on "blaze8-12"; also include, per VM state, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining and the completed migration count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), VMStateVariation AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), VMStateMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.max_memory_mb_next_2, vsv.coefficient_of_variation, vsmc.completed_migration_count FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN VMStateVariation AS vsv ON md.vm_state = vsv.vm_state JOIN VMStateMigrationCounts AS vsmc ON md.vm_state = vsmc.vm_state WHERE (vsmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(completed_migration_count) FROM VMStateMigrationCounts)) > 0.10 ORDER BY vsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, md.migration_id;

SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each instance display name, show its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory size (in MB) across records (only for instances that have extra metadata and are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state), also include the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), AvgStddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgStddev a;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH VmStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), InstanceWindowMaxExtraId AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT iw.uuid, iw.display_name, iw.vm_state, iw.power_state, iw.memory_mb, iw.vcpus, iw.max_instance_extra_id_next2, vsmv.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceWindowMaxExtraId AS iw JOIN VmStateMemoryVariance AS vsmv ON iw.vm_state = vsmv.VM_STATE ), VmStateMaxOfWindowedExtra AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, MAX(inner_cte.max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS max_windowed_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON inner_cte.uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ) SELECT vm_state, max_windowed_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM VmStateMaxOfWindowedExtra;

question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12' in availability zone 'flare3' (keeping only VM states whose total memory across instances exceeds 50000 MB), list the VM state, the per-state total memory (MB) with its overall benchmark and memory category, and also the per-state average/root-disk range/variance (GB) for non-deleted instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type' along with the overall root-disk benchmark and root-disk category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
sql: WITH memory_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.total_memory_mb, a.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > a.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < a.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), root_gb_by_state AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS benchmark_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.avg_root_gb, ic.root_gb_range, ic.root_gb_variance, b.benchmark_avg_root_gb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_root_gb > b.benchmark_avg_root_gb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROOT_GB' WHEN ic.avg_root_gb < b.benchmark_avg_root_gb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROOT_GB' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROOT_GB' END AS root_gb_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ) SELECT mbs.VM_STATE, mbs.total_memory_mb, mbs.benchmark AS memory_benchmark, mbs.memory_category, rgs.avg_root_gb, rgs.root_gb_range, rgs.root_gb_variance, rgs.benchmark AS root_gb_benchmark, rgs.root_gb_category FROM memory_by_state mbs JOIN root_gb_by_state rgs ON mbs.VM_STATE = rgs.vm_state ORDER BY mbs.total_memory_mb DESC;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), StddevAverage AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM StddevAverage) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, (ic.coefficient_of_variation - ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cov ac ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH MemoryVarianceStddevByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT mvs.VM_STATE, mvs.memory_mb_variance, mvs.memory_mb_stddev, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM MemoryVarianceStddevByState mvs JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByState gmm ON mvs.VM_STATE = gmm.vm_state ORDER BY mvs.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each instance display name matching the regular expression 'prime', among instances that are not deleted and have a non-deleted network info cache record, return the instance’s average memory (MB), memory variance, and migration MEMORY_REMAINING coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across completed migrations, but only keep instances whose migration MEMORY_REMAINING coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such 'prime' instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMemoryCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN MigrationMemoryCV AS mmcv ON ims.display_name = mmcv.display_name ORDER BY mmcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, ims.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC, inner_cte.display_name;
sub_questions: For each instance display name, return the coefficient of variation of the instance’s migration memory remaining (MEMORY_REMAINING) across its migrations, considering only migrations with STATUS = 'completed' and only instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.

For each instance display name, calculate the average and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted, that have a network info cache record, and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'.

For each instance display name matching the regular expression 'prime', among instances that are not deleted and have a non-deleted network info cache record, return the instance’s average memory (MB) and memory variance, and also the coefficient of variation of migration MEMORY_REMAINING across that instance’s completed migrations.
sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC;

WITH MigrationMemoryCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN MigrationMemoryCV AS mmcv ON ims.display_name = mmcv.display_name ORDER BY mmcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, ims.display_name;

question: For availability zone "flare3", how many instances have non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO and have a VM_STATE that appears in the per-VM-state geometric mean of migrated MEMORY_TOTAL (computed only from migrations with MEMORY_TOTAL > 0 and non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO), and what is the average of those geometric-mean migrated-memory values across the matching VM states? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fir.UUID) AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, AVG(vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states FROM flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS fir JOIN vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS vsgmmm ON fir.VM_STATE = vsgmmm.vm_state WHERE fir.NETWORK_INFO <> '';
sub_questions: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and the geometric mean of the total memory migrated (MEMORY_TOTAL) across migrations for instances that have a non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO, considering only migrations where MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than 0.

For instances in availability zone "flare3", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, and the cached network info, and assign row numbers within each VM state ordered by memory (descending).
sub_sqls: SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC;

SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3';

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, hostname, cached network_info JSON, and the running sum of instance IDs within its VM state (ordered by instance ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per VM state and the average of those per-state totals across VM states; also include the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory_mb for the "forge" display name (among non-deleted instances that have system metadata and where the display name has more than 5 such instances) and how far that standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) deviates from the overall average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts ), display_name_memory_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.NETWORK_INFO, f.window_column, f.total_forge_instances_in_state, f.avg_forge_instances_per_state, dms.memory_mb_stddev, dms.deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM forge_instances f JOIN display_name_memory_stddev dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.UUID;

For each instance display name, show the standard deviation of the instance memory size (in MB) across instances that have at least one system metadata entry, considering only instances that are not deleted.

SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For completed migrations, show the per-row migration/instance/system-metadata details for instances on host “ether-18” (with destination compute suppressed when it repeats), including for each destination compute the total rows returned and the minimum migration memory remaining; also include the host-level metric for host “blaze8-12” (the maximum across instances of each instance’s minimum observed memory remaining) and compute the ratio of the destination-compute minimum memory remaining to that blaze8-12 host metric.
sql: WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ROUND( ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4 ) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM ether_dest_compute_details ed CROSS JOIN blaze_host_minmax bh ORDER BY ed.dest_compute, ed.migration_id, ed.metadata_key;

For migrations with status equal to "completed" and where the instance is on host "ether-18", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration instance UUID, the instance display name, instance vm state, instance memory (MB), instance vcpus, the system metadata key and value for that instance, and the minimum migration memory remaining within each destination compute group (ordered by destination compute).

sub_sqls: SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18';

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that have non-deleted system metadata with key image_image_type and also had completed migrations with positive memory processed, show the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, completed migration count, total memory processed (bytes), and the dense-rank window value computed by ordering instances by memory (MB) using the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT subq2.instance_uuid, subq2.instance_display_name, subq2.availability_zone, subq2.completed_migration_count, subq2.total_memory_processed, subq1.window_column AS memory_dense_rank_window FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.instance_uuid = subq1.instance_uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_processed DESC;

For each instance on host blaze8-12 that had a completed migration, list the instance UUID, the instance display name, and the instance availability zone, along with the number of completed migrations for that instance and the total memory processed (in bytes) across those migrations.
sub_sqls: SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12';

SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone;

question: For each instance display name and instance availability zone, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of completed migrations per instance. Include subtotals for each availability zone and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), ZoneAgg AS ( SELECT i.availability_zone, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(migration_count_range) AS avg_migration_count_range, AVG(migration_count_variance) AS avg_migration_count_variance, AVG(migration_count_stddev) AS avg_migration_count_stddev FROM ZoneAgg GROUP BY availability_zone, display_name WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", list the availability zone (suppressing repeats and including subtotal rows per zone), instance ID, display name, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone by instance ID, and also show (by matching on display name) the variance of instance memory_mb among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, the overall average of these per-display-name variances, and each display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH mem_var_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), shelved_offloaded_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(availability_zone) OVER (ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, id) = availability_zone THEN NULL ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column, total_instances_in_az FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE availability_zone END AS az_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_az FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, id ) SELECT soi.availability_zone, soi.id, soi.display_name, soi.network_info, soi.window_column AS rank_in_availability_zone_by_id, soi.total_instances_in_az, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance, mv.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM shelved_offloaded_instances AS soi LEFT JOIN mem_var_by_display_name AS mv ON soi.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY soi.availability_zone, soi.id;

question: For each instance display name (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), show the memory range and memory variance (MB) along with the overall average memory range benchmark and its variability category, and also show the average memory and memory variance (MB) along with the overall average variance benchmark and its variance category. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ar.avg_memory_range_mb AS benchmark_memory_range_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_range_mb > ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_range_mb < ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.benchmark_memory_range_mb, q1.variability_category, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS variance_benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name;

question: For each instance VM state, return the VM state and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_REMAINING divided by the average MEMORY_REMAINING) for completed migrations, restricted to instances on host "blaze8-12". sql: SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(instance_uuid) OVER (ORDER BY instance_sort, instance_uuid, metadata_key) = instance_uuid THEN NULL ELSE instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column, metadata_rows_per_instance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE instance_uuid END AS instance_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, MAX(display_name) AS display_name, MAX(vm_state) AS vm_state, MAX(memory_mb) AS memory_mb, MAX(vcpus) AS vcpus, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE metadata_value END AS metadata_value, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_uuid) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE MAX(window_column) END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS metadata_rows_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_uuid, metadata_key, metadata_value WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY instance_sort, instance_uuid, metadata_key) SELECT q1.host, q1.max_of_min_instance_id_across_display_names, q1.max_of_avg_memory_mb_across_display_names, q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column, q2.metadata_rows_per_instance FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

sql: WITH InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, cmm.status, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at FROM InstanceMemoryStats ims JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory cmm ON ims.display_name = cmm.display_name;

sql: WITH instance_state_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS AS total_vcpus FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state WITH ROLLUP ), vmstate_migration_activity_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM sql: WITH MigrationStatusRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'prime3-77'), InstanceMetadataMemoryAvgs AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT msr.migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT msr.migration_id) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT imam.instance_uuid) AS total_instances_with_metadata, AVG(imam.window_column) AS avg_running_avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(msr.window_column) AS max_migration_rank_within_status FROM MigrationStatusRanks AS msr CROSS JOIN InstanceMetadataMemoryAvgs AS imam GROUP BY msr.migration_status ORDER BY total_completed_migrations DESC;

question: On host blaze8-12, for each VM state and instance display name among instances with more than 8 VCPUs whose group minimum memory is at least 75% of the maximum group minimum memory, return the instance count, the group minimum memory (MB), the minimum-memory-to-maximum-minimum-memory ratio, and how many image_image_type system-metadata rows (with above-average 2-preceding/2-following windowed average memory) match that same display name. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) >= 0.75 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, metadata_key, metadata_value, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY window_column DESC, instance_uuid ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.min_memory_vs_max_ratio, COUNT(q2.instance_uuid) AS matching_metadata_rows FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.instance_display_name GROUP BY q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.min_memory_vs_max_ratio ORDER BY q1.min_memory_vs_max_ratio DESC, q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) >= 0.75;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, metadata_key, metadata_value, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY window_column DESC, instance_uuid;

question: For instance display names that have a number of completed migrations greater than the average completed-migration count across all instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata, list the display name and its completed migration count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT display_name, migrations FROM inner_cte WHERE migrations > (SELECT AVG(migrations) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migrations DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations, considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata.

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations, show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the instance’s total memory (MB) and vCPU count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb, MAX(i.vcpus) AS vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC;

question: For each quota resource type, show the resource name and the geometric mean of reservation deltas for reservations linked to that quota usage (considering only reservations where the delta is greater than 0), but return only those resources whose geometric mean is greater than the overall average geometric mean across all resources. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT q.RESOURCE AS resource, EXP(AVG(LN(r.DELTA))) AS geometric_mean FROM QUOTA_USAGES AS q JOIN RESERVATIONS AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.DELTA > 0 GROUP BY q.RESOURCE ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC) SELECT resource, geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration details (migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, instance memory MB, vCPUs, instance extra id, migration memory total, and the per-migration-type minimum memory total window column), but only for instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state whose total instance memory (summed across system metadata entries) is greater than 50000 MB and also greater than the average of those qualifying totals; additionally compute the ratio of migration MEMORY_TOTAL to that instance total memory.
sql: WITH mem_over_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), completed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id) = MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, migration_id, INSTANCE_UUID, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, MEMORY_MB, VCPUS, instance_extra_id, MEMORY_TOTAL, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id), filtered_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT cm.migration_type, cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, moa.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN mem_over_avg moa ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = moa.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cm.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id, fcm.INSTANCE_UUID, fcm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_HOST, fcm.DISPLAY_NAME, fcm.VM_STATE, fcm.MEMORY_MB, fcm.VCPUS, fcm.instance_extra_id, fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL, fcm.window_column, fcm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL / NULLIF(fcm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS migration_memory_to_instance_total_memory_ratio FROM filtered_completed_migrations fcm ORDER BY fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000;

SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed';

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id) = MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, migration_id, INSTANCE_UUID, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, MEMORY_MB, VCPUS, instance_extra_id, MEMORY_TOTAL, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', for the top 10 instance display names with the most instance info cache records, return each display name’s cache record count, the average cache record count across those top 10 and its deviation from that average, along with the display name’s memory variability metrics (memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) and its memory variability category compared to the overall average memory range across all non-deleted instances. Do not return any rounded answers. Compare the memory range to the average memory range across all (non-deleted) instance display names, categorizing each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
sql: WITH mem_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, ar.avg_memory_mb_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.memory_mb_range > ar.avg_memory_mb_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN c.memory_mb_range < ar.avg_memory_mb_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), net_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC ) SELECT n.display_name, n.cache_records, n.avg_cache_records, n.deviation_from_avg, m.memory_mb_range, m.memory_mb_variance, m.memory_mb_stddev, m.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_range_benchmark, m.variability_category FROM net_inner_cte n JOIN mem_inner_cte m ON n.display_name = m.display_name ORDER BY n.cache_records DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC;

SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, ar.avg_memory_mb_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.memory_mb_range > ar.avg_memory_mb_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN c.memory_mb_range < ar.avg_memory_mb_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;

question: For each instance VM state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance root disk size (ROOT_GB) considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and that are running on host 'blaze8-12'. sql: SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC;

question: How many completed migrations are associated with instances running on host "blaze8-12", and how many instances in availability zone "flare3" are running on host "blaze8-12"? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH completed_migrations_on_blaze AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), flare3_instances_metadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fim.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instance_count FROM completed_migrations_on_blaze cm CROSS JOIN flare3_instances_metadata fim;
