For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are running on host "blaze8-12", list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra flavor JSON, the system metadata key and value, and assign row numbers within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID.

SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12';

question: For the top 10 non-deleted instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' (ranked by the number of network info cache records), return each instance display name along with its network info cache record count, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata row counts per completed migration, and the percentage of completed migrations whose memory remaining is less than 25% of memory total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopCacheInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), MetadataStatsPerInstance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT tci.DISPLAY_NAME, tci.cache_records, mspi.metadata_count_range, mspi.metadata_count_variance, mspi.metadata_count_stddev FROM TopCacheInstances tci JOIN MetadataStatsPerInstance mspi ON tci.DISPLAY_NAME = mspi.display_name ORDER BY tci.cache_records DESC ), migration_memory_pressure AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG( CASE WHEN m.memory_total IS NOT NULL AND m.memory_total > 0 AND m.memory_remaining IS NOT NULL AND (m.memory_remaining * 1.0 / m.memory_total) < 0.25 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END ) AS pct_migrations_memory_remaining_lt_25pct FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' AND m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_records, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, mmp.pct_migrations_memory_remaining_lt_25pct FROM inner_cte ic JOIN migration_memory_pressure mmp ON mmp.display_name = ic.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC;
sub_questions: List the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of network info cache records, considering only instances that are not deleted and whose display name matches the pattern 'prime'.

For each instance display name, report the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of system-metadata rows per migration for that instance, considering only migrations with status = 'completed' and only instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'.

For the top 10 non-deleted instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' (ranked by the number of network info cache records), return each instance display name along with its network info cache record count and the range, variance, and standard deviation of system-metadata row counts per completed migration.

SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC;

WITH TopCacheInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), MetadataStatsPerInstance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT tci.DISPLAY_NAME, tci.cache_records, mspi.metadata_count_range, mspi.metadata_count_variance, mspi.metadata_count_stddev FROM TopCacheInstances tci JOIN MetadataStatsPerInstance mspi ON tci.DISPLAY_NAME = mspi.display_name ORDER BY tci.cache_records DESC;
